{{Top|leg}}
'''Psychokinetic attack''' was a [[Ta-Ree]] spell capable of being wielded by [[Ascendant (Kathol)|Ascendants]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kathol (planet)|Kathol]]. The spell allowed the caster to launch a [[Psychokinesis|psychokinetic]] attack that could injure or even kill a target. The method or injuring or killing was varied, and could include collapsing the trachea, stirring the brain, or squeezing the heart.

Ascendants who wished to cast the spell were required to know the [[block pain]], [[deadly touch]], [[Inflict Pain|inflict pain]], [[sense life]], and [[psychokinesis]] spells.
